About Me

I am a BSc Computer Science and Engineering student at Metropolitan University, Sylhet, with an overall CGPA of 3.93 / 4.00 across my first seven semesters.

I have worked with C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL. My projects range from full-stack web applications to hardware work and social-impact concepts.

My current academic direction is becoming increasingly research-driven. I am particularly interested in research-driven software, human-centered technology, access to trustworthy information, and building systems that can create practical value for real people.

Illustrative design only · Research & development stage

GradMap BD is a research-based graduate study discovery and planning system for Bangladeshi students exploring Master's and PhD opportunities. The ongoing project investigates how verified program information, personalized requirement discovery, readiness checks, and planning tools can help students identify admission requirements they might otherwise miss.

Research & Requirements AnalysisOfficial-Source DataWeb System DesignUI/UX PrototypingProgram & Supervisor Matching

Research & Planned Features

  • Official-source Master's and PhD program requirements
  • Personalized requirement discovery and readiness checks
  • Program and potential supervisor matching
  • Funding, deadlines, and document planning
  • Evidence links and verification status for collected data

SkillBridge

For employers

Illustrative interface concept

SkillBridge is a two-sided employment platform focused on university students. Students can present their skills, explore internships and projects, and apply within the platform while employers post opportunities and manage applicants. Its matching approach is based on a locally implemented K-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm.

Web PlatformKNN MatchingStudent ProfilesApplications

Key Features

  • Student and employer account workflows
  • Internship, part-time job, and micro-project listings
  • Skills-based opportunity and candidate recommendations
  • In-platform applications and hiring status updates

Terra Trend

Earth Data Analysis & Visualization · NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

GitHub Repository ↗
Website screenshot · Illustrative offline example available

Terra Trend is an interactive Earth-science website built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It helps users explore environmental indicators over time, compare locations, and interpret charts and statistical evidence. The website includes a clearly labeled offline demonstration; live NASA data connectivity is being validated.

NASA POWEREnvironmental DataData VisualizationTrend Analysis

Key Features

  • Location-based environmental data exploration
  • Temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind, and solar indicators
  • Time-series charts, trend estimates, and confidence intervals
  • Location comparisons and downloadable analysis results
